title: True Comportment is the Mechanism of Self-Surrender
content_summary: Two-panel slide: left lists Problem/Solution/Metaphor; right shows a Desire vs Gratitude diagram with a Quranic quotation.
text_blocks: True Comportment is the Mechanism of Self-Surrender
The Problem: Desire traps humans in egocentricity.
The Solution: Comportment (the way one carries oneself) and Gratitude structure every act of worship as a form of self-surrender.

The Metaphor: Early etiquette literature urges the believer to sit before food as a slave sits before a master. Without prioritizing the blessing of sustenance over the self, human beings are reduced to animals.
O believers, eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and give thanks to God, if it be Him that you serve.
Provision is named first; gratitude follows; service is the frame the whole transaction sits inside.

Historian Farhad Daftary notes this debt-structure was the exact operational logic of the early Ismaili missionary network (2nd-4th centuries). The network propagated not by institutional appointment, but by this nested obligation—master to disciple, link by link.

title: The Cosmic Design: Physical Veils Immortalize Spiritual Realities
content_summary: A cosmic cross-section diagram with outer shell and inner sweet drink, plus explanatory text blocks.
text_blocks: The Cosmic Design: Physical Veils Immortalize Spiritual Realities
The Preservation Mechanism: God hid spiritual realities inside physical creations to immortalize them. Generations pass, but external nature and internal reality live forever.

The Operational Backbone: As historian Heinz Halm notes, this cosmic outer/inner distinction mirrors the missionary network itself. The wider community practices the outer form; the chain of trustees protects the inner secret.
The Outer Shell (Physical world, Exoteric practices, The Sky/Earth)
The distinction between outer and inner is not just textual interpretation—it is deliberate cosmic engineering.

title: God Marries Human Need with Divine Provision
content_summary: An infinity-loop diagram pairing Need (Demand) with Provision (Supply) joined by The Intellect.
text_blocks: God Marries Human Need with Divine Provision
God creates humans small, needy, and ignorant, so that they realize their absolute need.
God creates our spiritual sustenance first, entrusting His chosen intermediaries (Imams, callers) with the knowledge of all realities.
The mechanism forced by ignorance to seek out the provision.
Core Principle: By ensuring the fountainheads of knowledge are already in place before the ignorance of the intellect forces a search, God leaves no argument against Hin messengers are sent.

title: The Accustomed Way: Spiritual Infancy Requires Gradual Maturation
content_summary: A 4-step staircase diagram showing the levels of spiritual maturation with precondition and metaphor sidebars.
text_blocks: The Accustomed Way: Spiritual Infancy Requires Gradual Maturation
Smallness is a precondition for greatness, and ignorance is a sign pointing toward knowledge.
Just as you cannot feed heavily spiced rice to a newborn who only knows how to drink milk, spiritual infants must assimilate lower forms of knowledge first.

title: Prudent Concealment: The Five Conditions Shield
content_summary: A concentric-ring shield diagram listing five conditions of prudent concealment around a central rule.
text_blocks: Prudent Concealment: The Five Conditions Shield
Do not visit the scholar unprompted
Do not ask until the topic is raised
Do not mention him to your father

The disciple is the son of a prominent Arab tribal leader from a rival community that rejected the Imam. The stakes are life and death. Prudent concealment dictates he must stay with his father and respect him outwardly, while silently holding his inner allegiance to protect both the call and his own life.

title: The Ultimate Differentiator: The Covenant Renders Action Sacred
content_summary: A Sacred-vs-Profane matrix comparing Fornication/Marriage and Stolen/Valid Charity with insight callouts.
text_blocks: The Ultimate Differentiator: The Covenant Renders Action Sacred
Differentiated only by the formality of the contract.
The Stolen Apples: The 5th Imam's mathematics of theft.
Stealing 5 apples (5 sins) and giving them to charity (5 more sins for propagating forbidden goods) yields 10 sins, zero reward.
Insight: True knowledge belongs to the Imam.
Acts of piety performed without the covenant of allegiance are stolen goods. What is stolen cannot be sanctified.
